$comment: Endpoints that transfer binary data directly over the serial link using COBS encoding, separate from the JSON request/response. Only card.binary.put and card.binary.get stream raw bytes. All other binary operations use the card.binary buffer as an intermediary and are listed in binary_buffer.json instead. 'direction' is relative to the host: 'send' = host->notecard, 'receive' = notecard->host.
